platform: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04; Wasm32 programs executed under SDK Node, not Godot or a browser
dependency_policy: Verify SDK Git source, selected release identity and actual compiler/Node versions before building; retain actual downloaded archive/tool/library hashes and SDK/runtime license notices. Do not update existing toolchain locks or historical M11 workflow.
optional_cases: 24 normal cases: tail8/tail16,512/1024/2048,absent/unread/clustered/dispersed; same C++ source as qualified desktop specimens
touch_cases: 3 normal cases:serial1/phased1/phased4; exact registered unused-this-capture removal in generated copy only
abi: Injected compile-time sizeof(void*)==4 assertion; Current Cell remains size/alignment8/8; measure pointer/owner sizes rather than importing x86-64 values
diagnostics: Retain compiler/cache initialization output; compiler warnings/errors and nonzero exits refuse. Every runtime stderr must be empty. No sanitizer coverage claimed.
execution_order: Seal all three JS/Wasm asset sets before any case; optional tail8 then16, ascending side and registered state order, followed by three touch modes
failure_policy: Preserve any setup/build/runtime/provenance/accounting/projection failure; no selective retry under this registration. Changed source requires a new version and fresh full collection.
